description: SPKC, Latvia's Centre for Disease Prevention and Control, is the official producer of health and health care statistics in the country. Its statistics data page links the health statistics database, with indicators on population health, mother and child health, health care, mortality, health behaviour, outcomes and patient safety, and offers downloadable tables and survey data. A health care statistics yearbook with chapters on resources, outpatient care, emergency medical care, inpatient care and mortality is available for 2014 to 2018, and further pages give monthly and annual infectious disease reports and interactive visualisations. Coverage is national, with regional detail in some indicators. The tables are free and available to download from the SPKC site in Latvian, with some English; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: the yearbook stops at 2018, recent figures are spread across the database, downloads and dashboards, and visualisations cannot be exported. Simulation uses: sizing hospital and emergency care capacity, estimating baseline service demand and tracking epidemic load on the health system. Related records: Latvia healthcare waste social LCA (data-latvia-healthcare-waste-social-lca) uses Latvian hospital data, and the WHO health infrastructure indicators (data-who-gho-health-infrastructure-indicators) give comparisons.
